dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is the torch running today?

dialogues.speaker: Rakitina
dialogues.text: Judging by the sound, the exhaust pipes are a little clogged... Fortunately, it hasn't caused any real performance issues, but I'll need to figure out a way to clear them out...

dialogues.speaker: Rakitina
dialogues.text: Hehe, honestly, this Kresnik's Torch isn't even considered big. The largest one of them all is running right beneath the Snezhnograd!
